Last week, I met with @BeTheMatch to discuss the importance of bone marrow transplants. I know from personal experience that these transplants save lives, and I was glad to see these two Ohioans working to get patients around the world the life-saving treatment they need. https://t.co/ZbuLMvyc7U
Billions of dollars were stolen from the American taxpayer through unemployment insurance fraud during COVID, and we owe it to all taxpayers to get a full accounting.
Americans deserve better. We cannot lose sight of the undeniable fact that every life has value. https://t.co/zuRDrw5b4h

I introduced the bipartisan Treat and Reduce Obesity Act (TROA) of 2023 with @RepRaulRuizMD to provide Medicare beneficiaries with additional treatment and coverage options for obesity, helping the many Americans struggling to receive the care they need. https://t.co/ZX2hokX0nb

Despite years of work in Congress to negotiate balanced and bipartisan patient protections from surprise medical bills, agency bureaucrats continue to implement the No Surprises Act, counter to the law, in a way that harms patients, restricts access to care, and has financially strained medical providers across the country. 

I outlined these issues during a Ways and Means Committee hearing this week, watch here:

This week, I met with Biden Administration officials on the failed implementation of the No Surprises Act, violating the law as written by Congress and signed by President Trump.

It's vital we protect patients from unexpected medical bills and ensure that Agency officials implement the law as Congress intended. Thank you @RepJasonSmith for hosting the roundtable on this important issue.

This week, I visited the Hocking Valley Community Hospital for a tour of their urgent care, clinical, and outpatient facilities with CEO Stacey Gabriel. 

Critical Access Hospitals are vital to providing care for our rural communities and I will continue to be a voice for them in Washington to ensure that we are addressing the unique challenges they face.

Last week, I testified before the @EdWorkforceCmte about my bill, the #SafeStepAct, which provides guardrails for patients to make sure health insurance companies follow a clear process that allows patients to get their needed medication. Thank you, @virginiafoxx for allowing me to discuss this bipartisan legislation.

Proud to see the Lower Costs, More Transparency Act, H.R. 5378, pass in the house this week. This bipartisan bill puts patients at the center of their health care by ensuring they have timely and accurate information on the cost of services and medication. The bill also supports community health centers, which are vital to serving rural communities.

If we do not swiftly act to address recent cuts to the Medicare physician reimbursement rates now, and in the long term, the nation's physician shortage will continue to rise, rural communities and underserved areas will become health care deserts, and America's seniors will be left with no option for high quality, affordable health care. 

My fellow @GOPDoctors and I spoke on the House floor about the recent 3.4% cut to the Medicare physician fee schedule and how this will hurt patient access to health care. I urge Congressional leadership to put the health of Americans first and stop the full cut. Watch my full remarks below.

I had a great visit to PharmaLogic yesterday for a tour of their state-of-the-art facilities and a discussion on pharmaceutical advancements and improving health care for all Americans. https://t.co/K4UaMGreuf

I enjoyed my visit to @Alkermes facility in Wilmington, Ohio, for a tour of their state-of-the-art facilities. Their work in developing innovative medicines to treat psychiatric and neurological disorders is critical to expanding the health spans of Americans and I am proud of the work being done right here in #OH02 to make America the Healthiest Nation on the Planet.

Relying on foreign adversaries like China for basic medical supplies not only threatens the lives of our service members but also threatens the health spans of all Americans. 

At a @waysandmeansGOP hearing yesterday, I spoke about the importance of manufacturing these items here at home.

I am proud the House voted to protect individuals with chronic illnesses and disabilities from discrimination today by passing legislation I helped lead, the Protecting Health Care for All Patients Act (H.R. 485). 

https://t.co/wvW8lcMUAQ
I spoke in favor of legislation I helped lead, the Protecting Health Care for All Patients Act, on the House floor. Watch my full remarks👇

I enjoyed my visit with @TriHealth and touring Good Samaritan Hospital's phenomenal facilities, including their free health clinic, food pantry, and College of Nursing and Health Science. 

We had a fruitful discussion on investments in behavioral health and preparing our future health care workers for success.

This week is National Salute to Veteran Patients Week. As a physician, lawmaker, and veteran, I am proud of the work we have done so far to improve the health care veterans receive every day, and I am committed to ensuring all of our nation's veterans get the care they deserve. https://t.co/hvIwUlYOku

I joined @RepGregMurphy for a press conference to discuss our bill, the EDUCATE Act, to bar federal funding from going to medical schools using divisive DEI practices. Our future physicians should be advanced on merit, not through acts of discrimination. Watch my full remarks 👇
I spoke in support of @michaelcburgess' Preventative Health Savings Act on the House floor yesterday. You can watch my remarks below. https://t.co/WdZzBFBZVe
